facts.summary: cext_* tool ops are serialized through one closure mutex in extensions/index.ts (pi runs sibling tool calls concurrently); ChromeExtSession in src/session.js is intentionally NOT internally serialized — a class-level serialize() was deleted to avoid the deadlock from launch() internally calling clos

package.json "pi.extensions" must point at "./index.ts" (root shim), not "./extensions": pi derives an extension's display name from the entry path's parent segment for local/drop-in installs, so "./extensions" makes pi label the extension "extensions" instead of "browser-extension-tester".
facts.detail: pi's own docs show "extensions": ["./extensions"] as the canonical package example, and pi strips the "extensions/" prefix only for npm:/git: sources — a local-path install (source:"local") falls back to path-segment naming, so the entry's parent dir becomes the label. facts.detail: cext_* only loads unpacked folders, so this is the only way to test a published store extension. Unpacked CRX keeps update_url in manifest, which Chrome ignores.
